name: RNArchBench
description: RNArchBench is a reproducible benchmark and replication suite for evaluating performance trade-offs between React Native Legacy Architecture, React Native New Architecture, and native Android. The suite provides benchmark applications, canonical empirical datasets, analysis scripts, figures, reproducibility utilities, and documentation for five performance scenarios: update-to-next-frame-callback delay, long-list scrolling, JS-driven and native-driven animations, JavaScript-native communication, and cold-start performance. Version 1.0.4 establishes a fully consistent SoftwareX artifact: the exact versioned GitHub tag, CFF metadata, manuscript, and Zenodo archive share the same reserved version DOI. It strengthens prospective reproducibility with strict canonical condition-grid validation, Scenario 4 timing boundaries that exclude correctness checks from throughput measurement, a separate full correctness diagnostic, a fully pinned analysis environment, figure-integrity checks, and CI APK builds. The software was developed as the replication artifact accompanying research on the performance implications of React Native architectural migration.
